title: Module-valued global RHom and resolved strict-tower model
statement: Let (C,J,R) be a ringed site and let A be a commutative ring with a ring map φ:A→Γ(R). In the module category and derived categories of [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-weil-abstract-derived-category], define Γ_A to be linear Hom from the unit followed by restriction along φ, globalHom(E,-)=RΓ_A(RHom(E,-)), and representative(L,-)=Γ_A(HomComplex(L,-)). Define resolved towers to be K-injective complexes of towers with injective terms. Their ordinary-limit comparison functors are lim followed by Q and globalHom, and the limit of the representative tower followed by Q. These are the existing definitions of the global-RHom derived-limits item, moved verbatim to a shared module; there is no new choice or change of meaning.
